text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for container crashloop on gpu-prod-3 pool. multiple restarts in last 4m, OOM and CUDA allocation failures reported. auto-escalating to oncall.

carla (oncall-sre): I'm on it. confirming scope and impact.

carla (oncall-sre): quick status - kube shows CrashLoopBackOff for runtime:v2.4.1 on nodes gpu-prod-3a/3b. restartCount ~ 18.

ryan (eng-runtime): looking at runtime logs now. last stack shows cublas alloc fail then illegal-instruction in fused_attention kernel. config: batch_size=16, kv_cache enabled.

carla (oncall-sre): tagging @tanya for customer impact. can you check support alerts?

tanya (prod-support): seeing elevated 5xx for hosted endpoints in eu-west-1. ~3.2% error rate over 5m, spike started ~04:12 UTC. two enterprise customers (acme-inc, atlas-ai) have high error volume. support pages opened.

ryan (eng-runtime): log snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T04:13:08Z] ERROR runtime: cuda: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED: out of memory
[2026-03-15T04:13:09Z] ERROR runtime: kernel fused_attention.cu:0x1a3f Illegal instruction (SIGILL)
[2026-03-15T04:13:09Z] INFO runtime: container restarting (exit code 139)
```

mai (sre): also seeing node-level OOMs on gpu-prod-3b: dmesg shows oom-killer invoked for "runtime_service". possible memory thrash across multiple pods.

carla (oncall-sre): mitigation plan suggestions: 1) remove pod from LB / scale to zero for affected pool, 2) disable fused kernels to fallback to safer kernels, 3) roll traffic to reserve capacity in other pools, 4) capture core and upload to eng-runtime.

ryan (eng-runtime): agreed. quick temporary toggles: set ENV REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1, reduce MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=1024, and set KV_CACHE=0 for the pod template. will prepare a canary image with mitigations.

carla (oncall-sre): commands to execute now: `kubectl scale deployment runtime-pool-gpu-prod-3 --replicas=0 -n production` then `kubectl annotate node gpu-prod-3b maintenance=true` to stop scheduling.

deploy-bot: Build 4872 promoted to staging. CI passed.

carla (oncall-sre): executing scale to 0 on pool (now). cordoning gpu-prod-3b. removing from LB.

tanya (prod-support): notifying affected customers: quick note sent to acme-inc that we are investigating; asking for any request IDs.

ryan (eng-runtime): capturing last core: `gcore $(pgrep runtime_service)` and uploading to /internal/bugs/3612346789/core-gpu-prod-3b. stack traces show failure inside custom fused attention path. suspect regression from quantized kernels landed in v2.4.1.

ryan (eng-runtime): temporary hotfix build: runtime:v2.4.1-hotfix1 with fused kernels disabled and a defensive allocation check. preparing rollout to dedicated reserve pool.

mai (sre): routing policy change: redirect eu-west-1 traffic to gpu-prod-1/2 pools until hotfix is live. creating traffic-exit rule now.

carla (oncall-sre): summary for incident channel: impacted pool gpu-prod-3, cause: fused-kernel illegal-instruction + OOM thrash leading to crashloops; customer impact: elevated 5xx ~3.2%, 2 enterprise customers impacted; mitigation: cordon node gpu-prod-3b, scale pool to 0, redirect traffic, hotfix image in progress.

tanya (prod-support): ticket INC-3612346789 created and linked to customer cases. templated status update queued.

ryan (eng-runtime): rolling hotfix to reserve pool now. commands: `kubectl set image deployment/runtime-reserve runtime=redwood/runtime:v2.4.1-hotfix1 -n production` then test with probes.

deploy-bot: rollout started for runtime-reserve -> 3/3 pods ready. health checks green.

carla (oncall-sre): canary traffic to hotfix looks good for 10 minutes, no repeats of cublas alloc errors.

tanya (prod-support): customer metrics improving. acme-inc reports partial recovery of requests. I'll hold on further notifications until we have stable 15m window.

ryan (eng-runtime): plan for next steps: revert fused-kernel commit from v2.4.1 branch, run full quantized regression suite, add defensive allocation path and an OOM metric with early throttling. scheduling patch PR.

carla (oncall-sre): handing off to night SRE mai at 05:00 UTC. major mitigations in place: pool scaled, nodes cordoned, traffic reroute, hotfix deployed to reserve. please watch for reintroduced traffic and any eviction loops.

mai (sre): ACK. I'll continue monitoring and start post-incident checklist. tagging eng-runtime for follow-up.

ryan (eng-runtime): assigning ENG-3612346789 to eng-runtime, owner: ryan. will follow up with timeline and postmortem writeup.

carla (oncall-sre): closing loop here. incident-bot: set incident status -> mitigated. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-3612346789 updated: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, postmortem_owner=ryan, sla_impact=true

carla (oncall-sre): notes for postmortem: investigate memory accounting across fused kernels, add canary gating for kernel changes, improve automatic fallback when CUBLAS alloc fails.

mai (sre): will schedule a 1hr postmortem sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

tanya (prod-support): leaving notes for customer comms follow-up. will send detailed incident report once PM approved.

ryan (eng-runtime): thanks all. I pushed the revert PR and started regression runs. will post updates in ENG-RUNTIME channel.

carla (oncall-sre): thanks team. moving thread to archive after handoff. :slightly_smiling_face:
